title: Built a 2022-2026 MNQ Tick-by-Tick + MBO Dataset for Order Flow Research
author: Ecstatic-Ordinary-24
selftext:
I've spent the last few years collecting and cleaning a continuous tick-by-tick + MBO (Level 3) dataset for CME Micro E-mini Nasdaq-100 (MNQ), covering January 2022 through mid-2026.

The dataset includes:

* Full order lifecycle (adds, modifies, cancels, executions)
* Queue position tracking
* Nanosecond timestamps
* Continuous contract rolls
* Gap audit (no missing trading sessions found)

I'm curious what kinds of research people here would run with data like this. Are you primarily using MBO for queue modeling, order-flow imbalance, execution simulation, or ML feature engineering?

I'd also be happy to discuss the schema or preprocessing choices if anyone is interested.

comments.author: artificial_life_MBE
comments.body: Will you be releasing the data for public use?

replies.author: Ecstatic-Ordinary-24
replies.body: The data is not public. I purchased it from a premium provider over a segmented period. Interested parties can access it privately.
